Hints: Different inputs must not share an output.|Use the horizontal line test.
Solution: An inverse on the original function's range is a function exactly when the original is one-to-one: distinct inputs give distinct outputs. A horizontal line may meet its graph at most once. A parabola on all reals fails, but its right branch is one-to-one. The function must be one-to-one.
